import pytest
from unittest.mock import patch, MagicMock
from fetcher import fetch

def test_timeout_set():
    mock_client = MagicMock()
    mock_response = MagicMock()
    mock_response.status_code = 200
    mock_client.get.return_value = mock_response
    
    # Ensure timeout=30 is passed
    with patch('fetcher.requests') as mock_requests:
        mock_requests.Session.get.return_value = mock_response
        fetch(mock_client, "https://example.com")
        mock_client.get.assert_called_once_with("https://example.com", timeout=30)

def test_exception_propagation():
    mock_client = MagicMock()
    mock_client.get.side_effect = Exception("Test timeout exception")
    
    with patch('fetcher.requests') as mock_requests:
        mock_requests.Session.get.side_effect = Exception("Test timeout exception")
        try:
            fetch(mock_client, "https://example.com")
            assert False, "Expected exception to be raised"
        except Exception:
            pass  # Expected
        mock_client.get.assert_called_once_with("https://example.com", timeout=30)

def test_other_exceptions_propagated():
    mock_client = MagicMock()
    mock_client.get.side_effect = ConnectionError("Connection failed")
    
    with patch('fetcher.requests') as mock_requests:
        mock_requests.Session.get.side_effect = ConnectionError("Connection failed")
        try:
            fetch(mock_client, "https://example.com")
            assert False, "Expected ConnectionError to be propagated"
        except ConnectionError:
            pass  # Expected
        mock_client.get.assert_called_once_with("https://example.com", timeout=30)

from unittest.mock import patch, MagicMock
from fetcher import fetch

# Test 1: Verify timeout=30 is passed to client.get
def test_timeout_passed():
    mock_client = MagicMock()
    mock_response = MagicMock()
    mock_response.status_code = 200
    mock_client.get.return_value = mock_response
    
    with patch('fetcher.client') as mock_client_patched:
        mock_client_patched.get.return_value = mock_response
        fetch(mock_client, "https://example.com")
        mock_client.get.assert_called_once_with("https://example.com", timeout=30)

# Test 2: Verify exception propagation without retries
def test_exception_propagation():
    mock_client = MagicMock()
    mock_client.get.side_effect = Exception("Test exception")
    
    with patch('fetcher.client', mock_client):
        try:
            fetch(mock_client, "https://example.com")
            assert False, "Expected exception to be raised"
        except Exception:
            pass  # Expected
        mock_client.get.assert_called_once_with("https://example.com", timeout=30)

# Test 3: Verify arguments and return value preserved
def test_arguments_and_return_value():
    mock_client = MagicMock()
    mock_response = MagicMock()
    mock_response.status_code = 200
    mock_response.data = b"test_data"
    mock_client.get.return_value = mock_response
    
    with patch('fetcher.client', mock_client):
        result = fetch(mock_client, "https://example.com")
        assert result == mock_response
        mock_client.get.assert_called_once_with("https://example.com", timeout=30)
